issues.title: Encoder channel response and post-replacement metric calibration
issues.original_failure_and_evidence: Early M2-M4 counts absent despite visually confirmed motors; replacement restored counts. September manual 40 cm legs produced ~21 cm wheel odometry. October M3 discrepancy is unqualified by isolated pulse.
issues.confirmed_findings: Different historical hardware/configuration generations; fresh packets do not establish each channel's response or distance accuracy.
issues.suspected_causes_and_limits: Slip, per-channel scale, mapping/sign, encoder hardware, turn normalization and sample timing remain alternatives for current discrepancies.
issues.test_results: Replacement had historical dynamic passes; current M3 not qualified; six Oct8 runs had zero pulse requests. Oct9 live idle health selected all M1-M4 with fresh packets; no dynamic M3 qualification follows.
issues.remaining_verification: After test-channel qualification: one bounded lifted M3 pulse with physical direction observation, then measured independent loaded forward/reverse runs. Never choose a channel only because it matches a desired distance.
issues.history_completeness: Indexed related available commits; not all raw historical occurrences independently reviewed

issues.title: USB role ambiguity and discovery starvation
issues.original_failure_and_evidence: USB discovery busy; expected one unclaimed verified device. Identical CH340 by-id aliases previously bound IMU as motor board.
issues.confirmed_findings: Shared identities require protocol verification; exclusive discovery lock contention delayed motor startup while GNSS retried.
issues.suspected_causes_and_limits: Exact starvation fairness/backoff solution not yet validated; cable/power faults are separate possibilities.
issues.test_results: Pausing GNSS around base restart restored startup (workaround). Passive identity unit tests do not prove cold-boot/swap endurance.
issues.remaining_verification: Motor power off: repeated simultaneous startup and controlled reconnect, absent/ambiguous device cases. Preserve one serial owner, bounded retries, no blind protocol writes.
issues.history_completeness: Indexed related available commits; not all raw historical occurrences independently reviewed

issues.remaining_verification: Record client send, owner callback entry/exit, serial receipt and cached sample using common monotonic clock; no-motion shadow instrumentation before any powered pulse.

issues.title: Commissioning heartbeat/readiness and observer cleanup
issues.original_failure_and_evidence: fresh_latched_stop_required; control_policy_stale; no_active_session; heartbeat_expired; diagnostic ROS shutdown hung.
issues.confirmed_findings: Initial policy period equalled its freshness deadline; request discovery and readiness needed gating. Temporary observer cleanup delay left test flags until explicitly restored.
issues.suspected_causes_and_limits: Remaining heartbeat delay could be sender, DDS, executor or blocking I/O; client send gap <=0.236 s alone cannot distinguish.
issues.test_results: 64 previous focused tests recorded. Five-second readiness achieved in one session then heartbeat failed; coalescing experiment reverted.
issues.remaining_verification: Three 60 s zero-output no-motion channel runs; injected missing heartbeat must abort; bounded timeout and unconditional cleanup verified. Never assert lifted conditions on a ground rover.

issues.confirmed_findings: Failure stage is connection establishment, before MTU/data parsing. Recovery restarted BMS at 09:23:36; healthy at 09:23:44 then failure returned.
issues.suspected_causes_and_limits: Phone contention, radio conditions, reconnect churn or Bluetooth stack remain unproved alternatives.
issues.test_results: Diagnostic-only labels deployed and 12 tests passed; no BLE repair claim. Healthy readings still alternated with connect failure after Oct9 freshness deployment, including 10:07:12 IST.
issues.remaining_verification: Observe existing single BLE owner; compare controlled phone-disconnected condition; capture bounded connection-stage evidence. No global Bluetooth reset that could affect remote control.

issues.title: Mapping startup race, stale places and pose corrections
issues.original_failure_and_evidence: Hall goal aborted with lethal start; named home coordinate disagreed with physical location. Oct4 drive preceded active session. Oct8 closure 0.082 m/2.99 deg but continuity gate failed.
issues.confirmed_findings: Start/session race established; map->odom component jump is origin-dependent, not physical displacement. Same-pose composition showed ~0.23 m correction; after hypothesis fit prior map better.
issues.suspected_causes_and_limits: Source of accumulated odometry/heading error still unresolved; not proven SLAM wrong-corridor match.
issues.test_results: Loop closure off no benefit; velocity-only mixed results rejected; zero TF offset translation worsened rejected; guessed deskew inconclusive. Saved bags available. Oct9 live safety reporter initially said SLAM MAP DATA LOST; a new transient-local subscriber received the saved map, and diagnostic-only reporter restart restored LOCALIZATION/map ONLINE. Root cause of stale prior status not proven; navigation remains unvalidated.
issues.remaining_verification: The operator confirmed the exact saved Dhruv Room point and heading; stationary scan/map fit identified the earlier out-of-map AMCL pose as wrong, and one saved-pose reseed corrected it. A new operator-confirmed Hall endpoint passes exact saved-map footprint clearance; the taught route still has an older map ID. The recorded manual Hall-to-home return showed >2 m stationary AMCL jumps, 32 traction samples with critical encoder consensus, and disagreement between wheel and IM10A yaw-rate integration. Different endpoint displacements alone do not establish wheel-distance scale error. Diagnose same-time scan/AMCL/odom/TF, wheel agreement and heading before autonomous motion. Audit stale mapping-session marker lifecycle; require an actual Nav2 plan and supervised recorded round trip only after localization is stable.

events.description: Hall goal aborted with lethal start; named home coordinate disagreed with physical location. Oct4 drive preceded active session. Oct8 closure 0.082 m/2.99 deg but continuity gate failed.
Loop closure off no benefit; velocity-only mixed results rejected; zero TF offset translation worsened rejected; guessed deskew inconclusive. Saved bags available.
10:07 IST dashboard API reported autonomy FAULT: STOP: SLAM MAP DATA LOST while encoder health alone was READY. Active SLAM map freshness requires diagnosis before motion.

Saved-map publisher was intermittently visible in ROS graph; a transient-local subscriber received its latched map. At 10:22 IST a diagnostic-only safety-reporter restart made its observed mode LOCALIZATION and map ONLINE, including at map age 27.68 s. Motor owner was unchanged. Why the old reporter marked the map LOST remains unresolved.

Operator confirmed rover is in Dhruv Room, not whether it occupies the exact saved home point. Live AMCL pose (-3.17,-0.22) is 3.67 m from named Dhruv Room pose (0.254,-1.539). Saved Oct8 seed (0.877,0.097) has no accepted-map ID. Localization service showed six start-preflight timeout restarts concurrent with repeated LiDAR hardware operation timeouts; missing scans are the likely immediate cause, not a demonstrated seed failure. Once running, Nav2 logs contained robot-out-of-map positions and one scan/TF cache drop. No motion or runtime change. Exact faulty coordinate source remains unproven.

Exact accepted PGM lookup put later live pose (-3.22,-0.25) in unknown 205 cells, while the saved Dhruv Room point was known free 254. A stopped 15-second diagnostic recorded fresh scans, zero wheel/EKF odometry drift and 0.004 m/1.09 degree AMCL drift. Added a saved-map known-clear start check before named-place and return-home goal dispatch; offline regression passed. Physical localization and room-route reliability remain unvalidated.

Operator confirmed exact saved Dhruv Room position and heading. Fresh LiDAR scan endpoints fit that map pose far better than the old out-of-map AMCL pose. Backed up the old localization seed and invoked the existing AMCL seed service once while stopped. Post-seed authoritative pose was about 9 cm from home, in known free space; 99% of fresh scan endpoints were within 15 cm of mapped walls, with motor speed zero. This does not qualify moving or reboot repeatability, the Hall endpoint, or the saved taught route.

Operator manually arrived in Hall and confirmed live map marker. Fresh stopped scan fit 98.9% within 15 cm at (6.279,-2.199); exact accepted-map 0.18 m clearance and grid connectivity to home passed. Old Hall waypoint was backed up. First save was incorrectly bound to an Oct8 mapping session left active while localization ran and SLAM was inactive; archived the stale marker and re-saved Hall with accepted map ID. Motor speed remained zero during save. Manual arrival was not captured by the dedicated demonstration recorder; taught-route map ID and autonomous repeatability remain unvalidated.

Dedicated Hall-to-Dhruv manual return bag captured fresh scan, odom, TF and AMCL. Remote-command interval had no >2 s data gap, but five AMCL steps exceeded 0.5 m after the remote stopped and odometry was stationary; largest was 2.206 m/130 degrees. The 4.236 m wheel-odom endpoint displacement does not prove distance under-reporting because its recorded path length was about 6.77 m. Of 65 unavailable encoder samples, 32 occurred with traction and CRITICAL/autonomy_ready=false health. Wheel-derived yaw-rate integration was about -143 degrees versus about -192 degrees from IM10A/EKF. Browser map refresh was bounded and stale data labelled, but root localization reliability remains unproven. No autonomous motion was commanded.

issues.title: Visual Cloud ingest destination is a placeholder and local history is stale
issues.original_failure_and_evidence: Active agent repeatedly logged DNS errors for atlas-visual-cloud.example. The checked-in cloud_url uses that example hostname; local history.sqlite3 was approximately 26.5 GB and last modified Oct4.
issues.confirmed_findings: Service-active status does not mean remote ingest succeeded. The server has an 86,400-row retention cap but SQLite deletion does not automatically shrink allocated pages.
issues.suspected_causes_and_limits: Exact deployment intent, current local ingest wiring and historical database growth rate have not been fully established. Database size is not evidence of a full disk; approximately 373 GB was free at the stopped-runtime check.
issues.test_results: Read-only configuration, journal, file metadata and disk checks only; no ingest repair or deployment.
issues.remaining_verification: Confirm intended authenticated endpoint and data flow; measure payload rate, retention and CPU/disk overhead. Change one existing collector only after preserving local safety and diagnostic continuity.
issues.history_completeness: Current runtime/config snapshot; older outages and remote endpoint history not exhaustively reviewed

events.description: Agent is active but sends to an example hostname and receives DNS failures; local history is stale and large. No new collector justified.

issues.title: Failed BMS reads republish stale scalar values
issues.original_failure_and_evidence: On a Daly BLE read failure, JSON reported ok:false but publish_data emitted prior voltage/current/SOC/cells on scalar topics. The agent refreshed its SOC age from scalar percent.
issues.confirmed_findings: Scalar topics carry no validity field, so copied readings appeared new. The JSON-based motor lifted-test gate already rejected unhealthy snapshots.
issues.suspected_causes_and_limits: This is a freshness-contract defect, not proof of the underlying BLE connection cause. Other dashboard consumers may cache last values and require their own explicit stale indication.
issues.test_results: 14 focused offline Daly tests and 12 agent-core tests passed; deployed with operator approval. Short healthy-runtime check passed with unchanged motor PID, but live failure behavior and BLE endurance remain unvalidated.
issues.remaining_verification: During a natural failed BLE read, verify invalid JSON, no new scalar message, immediate agent preflight denial and successful recovery on a later complete read; complete stopped endurance observation.
issues.history_completeness: Current source and live journal reviewed; historical consumer behavior not exhaustively replayed

events.description: Confirmed stale scalar republishing and agent SOC-age refresh. Source fix tested and deployed; short healthy-runtime pass only, invalid path still untested live.
